---
title: "Downloads"
---

The workbook below holds the carbon sequestration accounts of the EU27 for 2000, 2006, 2012, 2018 and 2024 by NUTS0, NUTS2 and
NUTS3, with one sheet per quantity and level. It covers the flow without the offset in physical terms, and the actual flow and
the missed flow in physical and monetary terms. Physical values are in thousand tonnes of CO2 and of carbon, and monetary values
are in million euro at current prices and at constant 2010 prices.

The 100 m maps are too large for the repository, so they are kept in an external folder. It holds 25 GeoTIFF files in about
14 GB, with five maps per year, namely the flow without the offset, the actual flow, the missed flow, and the value of the actual flow and of the missed
flow at constant 2010 prices. A `README.txt` file in that folder explains the units and how to read them. The missed flow is a balance
between removals and emissions, so its maps allocate the national value with the key of the actual flow, and they do not show where any loss of the
service occurs.

The [report](../documentation/methods/carbon-sequestration/index.qmd) explains how each product was built and how to read it.
